In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''decimated''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telfrey]]. Responding to the rebellious sentiments stirred up by [[Tay Vanis]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] had the planet's populace wiped out, and the world itself bombed into a dead, lifeless husk.
